// why this lives here: The panel is a browser Preact app: it needs the JSX transform and DOM types, which the
sidecar deliberately does not have. Editors resolve a file against the NEAREST tsconfig, so
keeping it in this folder is what makes VS Code show the same result as `npm run typecheck`.
With only a root config, every .tsx file reported 'Cannot use JSX unless the --jsx flag is
provided' while the CLI was perfectly green.
